title: 已完结热门小说推荐
content:
嗡~嗡~璀璨星河之下陈轩盘膝而坐，身上衣衫无风自起。正在凝聚全神消化着体内奔腾的寒霜灵气。逆天改命的惊喜固然值得喜出望外，但陈轩多年来磨炼出的沉稳心性让他并未高兴得忘乎所以。得赶紧消化，这来自柳清霜极为精纯的寒冰灵气若是不及时处理，足以将自己撑爆。而这便是足足一个时辰。在这之间他耳边不断响着系统声音。【你受到道侣“柳清霜”的灵气影响，灵根产生异变为极品冰灵根】【灵气突破瓶颈，你已进入锻体期一层】【……你已进入锻体期二层】……直到灵气全部消化吸收完毕。呼~届时陈轩长舒一口气，方缓缓睁眼。已是锻体期五层！锻体是步入修炼的第一个境界，然后筑基，算是开始真正走上修仙路，后面还有通玄、凝气、开光、紫府，紫府境是分水岭。成功构建紫府后，还有灵寂、洞虚、神玄、碎涅四个大境界。等柳清霜突破至凝气境，他或许就能直接突破锻体，进入通玄境！“原先的废灵根已经异变成了极品冰灵根，也就是说我现在可以施展冰属性的法术了。”“而这所谓的十倍修为返还，也就是柳清霜这次修炼所增长的灵气十倍，并非她全部修为的十倍。”“她可是通玄境界。”陈轩呢喃着感慨，旋即打开面前字幕。【宿主：陈轩】【境界：锻体五层】【已绑定道侣：柳清霜（亲密度3%）】【返还效果：十倍躺平返还】字幕很简单凝练。陈轩看着看着就心有所想，旋即拿出一颗低劣的聚气散吃下。嗯，宣！但是没啥用，灵气一点也没涨，反倒是耳边响起了系统的警告。【宿主只能进行躺平摆烂的行为，不可进行任何形式的修炼，否则会降低返还效果】【您目前在修“躺平软饭道”，关爱道侣，一步登天。】【提示：做个纨绔，吃喝嫖赌】陈轩：……合着躺平摆烂也得是007呗？也行，在这个修仙世界抱着冰山美人老婆的大腿，做个神雕侠侣岂不快哉！“去找媳妇儿聊聊天，双修什么的可以搞一搞了。”陈轩拍拍屁股起身，慵懒地伸了个腰。

咚咚！此时夜下敲门声响起。“陈少爷在吗？”院门外又是一声娇滴滴的喊叫。陈轩推开门，只见门前站着一个妙龄少女。其脸蛋略施淡妆精致可爱，鹅黄色束腰莲花裙轻轻浮动。略有香风拂面。看着有些面熟，但陈轩还是记不起她是谁。“陈少爷，我是音竹峰的小菲，现在是柳师姐的侍奉丫鬟。”小菲甜甜笑着。“嗯，有事吗？”陈轩警惕地看看四周。这月色朦胧孤男寡女的，要是有心之人看见了还不知道怎么编排他这个柳清霜的未婚夫呢。小菲说道：“我奉柳小姐的命令，前来请陈少爷去音竹峰喝茶。”“行。”陈轩点点头，便跟其离开独院，朝着音竹峰的方向走去。路上，他看似不经意间问道：“小菲，柳师姐可御剑飞行，怎么不飞来亲自与我说？”“呃……”小菲挽了挽鬓发，浅然笑说：“少爷莫怪！”“柳小姐修炼勤奋，下午开始便苦练神功暂时脱不开身，故令我前来请您。”“哦。”陈轩眼神变了变，接着不动声色地点头。此时二人来到了后山森林小道。“小菲，谁派你来的？”“少爷何出此言，我刚才不是说了……”小菲说着说着，突然发现陈轩已经站在了自己十米开外的距离。脸上冷峻阴沉。见状，她那人畜无害的脸蛋上浮起一抹冷笑。呵，还是被发现了。“你是怎么发现我的？”“别把人当傻子行不？”陈轩无语。老子刚消化完柳清霜修炼结束返还的灵气，结果你说她还在闭关？刚开始他就察觉出这娘们不太对劲，现在一试探果然居心叵测。“呵呵，看来你是有点脑子的，还真是小瞧了你这个废人。”事到如今小菲也不装了，直接摊牌。腰间银色丝带骤然抽出，便是一把如毒蛇般刁钻锐利的软剑，她冷说：“既是将死之人，那就让你走个明白。”“本姑娘乃是楚殿下麾下婢女，特来解决你这个令人作呕的腌臜之辈！”“柳小姐是何等的天之娇女，只有她才能配得上楚殿下的纵横之才！”“而你，区区一个废灵根的废物，也敢跟楚殿下抢女人？死不足惜！”
content_en:
Buzz~buzz~ Chen Xuan sat cross-legged under the bright stars, his clothes rising in the wind.He is concentrating all his energy to digest the frost spiritual energy rushing in his body.The surprise of changing his life against the odds was certainly worthy of overjoyment, but Chen Xuan's calm mind that he had honed over the years kept him from being so happy that he was carried away.He had to digest it quickly. If this extremely pure ice aura from Liu Qingshuang was not processed in time, it would be enough to burst him.And this is a full hour.During this time, system sounds kept ringing in his ears.[You are affected by the spiritual energy of the Taoist companion "Liu Qingshuang", and the spiritual roots mutate and become the best ice spiritual roots] [The spiritual energy breaks through the bottleneck, and you have entered the first level of the body training stage] [...You have entered the second level of the body training stage]... Until all the spiritual energy is digested and absorbed.Phew~ Then Chen Xuan let out a long sigh of relief and slowly opened his eyes.It’s already the fifth level of the body training stage!Physical training is the first level of cultivation, and then foundation building is the beginning of the true path to immortality. After that, there are Tongxuan, Qi Condensation, Consecration, and Zifu. The Zifu realm is the watershed.After the Zi Mansion is successfully constructed, there are four major realms: Lingji, Dongxu, Shenxuan, and Sui Nirvana.When Liu Qingshuang breaks through to the Qi Condensation Realm, he may be able to directly break through the body forging and enter the Tongxuan Realm!"The original waste spirit roots have mutated into top-grade ice spirit roots, which means that I can now cast ice-attribute spells." "And this so-called ten-fold return of cultivation means ten times the aura increased by Liu Qingshuang's practice this time, not ten times her total cultivation." "She is in the realm of Tongxuan." Chen Xuan murmured with emotion, and then opened the subtitles in front of him.[Host: Chen Xuan] [Realm: Fifth Level of Body Forging] [Bound Taoist Companion: Liu Qingshuang (Intimacy 3%)] [Return Effect: 10 times the return when lying flat] The subtitles are very simple and concise.Chen Xuan thought about it as he looked at it, and immediately took out a cheap Qi Gathering Powder and ate it.Well, Xuan!But it was of no use. The spiritual energy did not increase at all. Instead, a system warning sounded in my ears.[The host can only perform the behavior of lying flat and rotting, and cannot engage in any form of practice, otherwise the return effect will be reduced] [You are currently practicing the "Lying Flat and Soft Rice Tao", caring for Taoist companions, and reaching the sky in one step.】【Tips: Be a dandy, eat, drink, whore and gamble】Chen Xuan: ...If you lie down together and die, you have to be 007?Okay, in this world of cultivating immortals, wouldn’t it be great to hold the lap of the iceberg beauty wife and be a couple of the Condor Heroes!"Go and have a chat with your wife. We can start dual cultivation and other things." Chen Xuan patted his butt and stood up, stretching lazily.

Boom!At this time, there was a knock on the door at night."Is Mr. Chen here?" There was another delicate shout outside the courtyard gate.Chen Xuan opened the door and saw a young girl standing in front of the door.Her face is delicate and cute with light makeup, and her goose-yellow lotus skirt floats gently.Slightly fragrant breeze.She looked familiar, but Chen Xuan still couldn't remember who she was."Master Chen, I am Xiaofei from Yinzhu Peak, and now I am Senior Sister Liu's maid." Xiaofei smiled sweetly."Well, is something wrong?" Chen Xuan looked around cautiously.This moonlight is hazy, a man and a woman alone. If someone with a heart sees it, he still doesn't know how to arrange him as Liu Qingshuang's fiancé.Xiao Fei said: "I am here to invite Master Chen to have tea at Yinzhu Peak on the order of Miss Liu." "Okay." Chen Xuan nodded and followed him out of the Independent Courtyard and walked towards Yinzhu Peak.On the way, he seemed to ask casually: "Xiao Fei, Senior Sister Liu can fly with a sword, why don't you come and tell me in person?" "Uh..." Xiao Fei pulled back her hair and said with a smile, "Master, don't blame me!" "Miss Liu is diligent in cultivation and has been practicing magic skills hard since the afternoon, so I came to invite you." "Oh." Chen Xuan's eyes changed, and then he nodded calmly.At this time, the two came to the forest trail in the back mountain."Xiao Fei, who sent you here?" "Master, why did you say this? Didn't I just say..." Xiao Fei was talking and suddenly found that Chen Xuan was already standing ten meters away from her.His face was cold and gloomy.Seeing this, a sneer appeared on her harmless face.Oh, it was still discovered."How did you find me?" "Can you please stop treating people like fools?" Chen Xuan was speechless.I just finished digesting the spiritual energy that Liu Qingshuang returned after her training, but you said she is still in retreat?From the very beginning, he sensed that something was not right about this girl, and now he tested her and it turned out that she had ulterior motives."Haha, it seems that you have some brains, and you really underestimated this loser like you." Now Xiao Fei stopped pretending and went straight to show his cards.The silver ribbon around her waist suddenly pulled out, and it turned out to be a soft sword as sharp and sharp as a poisonous snake. She said coldly: "Since you are about to die, I will let you know clearly." "I am a maid under His Highness Chu, and I am here to deal with this order of yours."What a disgusting person!" "Miss Liu is such a beautiful woman.Only she can match His Highness Chu's talent!" "And you, a mere useless person, dare to rob a woman from His Highness Chu?"
